status: Next algorithm design only; not implemented or authorized for deployment/build/device
prerequisite: P5 identity64 explicit-role source must first pass its concrete native compile review. Any device acceptance remains independently scoped; source equivalence alone does not establish mixed execution.
first_transition: Separate BF16 EP16 vector-only32-worker candidate before introducing a mixed AIC/AIV launch. Its full32 physical participants enter the unchanged prelude barrier, so no mixed-kernel subset barrier is assumed. Existing64-worker implementation and all qualified libraries remain separate controls.
worker_schedule: Physical worker0..31 is logical hidden role0..31. Preserve all signal initialization, descriptor publication, directory loads and concurrent hidden producers/helpers. Do not serialize logical workers on fewer physical workers.

Each worker finishes its existing primary/Clos/helper/local/ForwardPeer duties and all their current completion/ACK obligations. Explicitly drain its outstanding local MTE stores before reusing the same scratch/events for auxiliary work.

That worker becomes auxiliary owner=physical worker with profile role=32+owner. Preserve independent FP32 gate-weight send/header/receive/expand behavior and its existing generation checks. Do not treat hidden readiness as gate-weight readiness.

After its auxiliary duties, drain local stores and let logical hidden role7 perform the existing incoming-terminal poll. All32 worker returns remain the final launch join. No next-epoch publication or buffer reuse occurs merely because one phase finished.
Initial scope is BF16 EP16; FP8 scale reuse and other world sizes require their own explicit scope and validation. No hidden removal of the existing FP8 path from frozen baselines.
dependency_reasoning: Existing source inspection found no hidden/relay/terminal dependency on auxiliary payload or its ready header. All peer descriptors are produced in the common prelude; auxiliary senders do not create the descriptor needed by hidden consumers.

Keeping all32 hidden roles concurrently active retains helper7 ACKs, local primary completion producers and ForwardPeer source readiness. Scheduling only a subset of hidden roles to completion first would introduce a dependency cycle.

A worker may enter auxiliary before other workers/ranks finish hidden work. This is permitted only if its own scratch/engine operations have fully retired and the original independent auxiliary protocol is retained. Source DAG analysis does not prove hardware scheduler/engine progress.
mixed_kernel_followup: Only after a separately verified phased32 vector candidate, map the32 communication roles onto the reserved AIV subblock1. AIV subblock0 continues full128-row activation, paired AIC executes up/down as in the independently validated P4 component.

Resolve the mixed prelude barrier explicitly. A separate finite communication preparation launch is an acceptable initial implementation with its launch cost included; never transplant a full64 SyncAll into a32-role subset.

Start with full persistent Xe. Communication producers cannot wait on compute-driven allocation reuse. Add per-tile logical-writer seals and actual completed queue frontiers only with real domain/epoch/sequence evidence and immutable notification sources.

Do not insert arbitrary additional CQ-producing checkpoints into the current two-outstanding-CQ/helper-ACK scheme. A control using existing true completion edges precedes a separately reviewed fine-grained checkpoint change.
mandatory_device_observations_for_a_futu: Fixed full-forward/backward numerical gates for balanced, zero_gate, empty and skew; actual loaded original/candidate identities and all rank counts, not just outputY.
Actual32-worker launch and role/aux coverage, all case-close and process-group exits, true node/supervisor statuses and verified own release. Preserve first failure rather than rerunning unchanged.

A later performance experiment needs matched scope/inputs/weights, instrumentation disabled, raw per-rank timings and timelines. The phased candidate does not itself demonstrate physical overlap or speedup.
